【EFN3.0 · 全新武器與戰鬥機制介紹】
【EFN3.0 · New Weapons & Combat Mechanics Introduction】

首先，謹向所有參與《EpicFight-Nightfall 3》製作的成員致以誠摯感謝：超級厲害寶寶全體成員、P1nero、Merlin204、東非大野豬，以及每一位支持我們的朋友！
First and foremost, we extend our sincere gratitude to all members involved in the production of "EpicFight-Nightfall 3": all members of Super Awesome Baby, P1nero, Merlin204, dfdyz, and every friend who has supported us!

加入Patreon：Super_Awesome_Baby | A Minecraft modder | Patreon 以支持我們有足夠資金繼續開發其他模組！您將在之後獲得後續的搶先測試模組

Join Patreon:  Super_Awesome_Baby | A Minecraft modder | Patreon to support us with sufficient funds to continue developing other mods! You will receive subsequent early access test modules in the future

推薦添加aaa粒子以獲得GuHao製作的部分特效 (版本>= 2.0)

It is recommended to add aaa particles to achieve some of the special effects created by GuHao (Version>= 2.0)

在經過長時間的開發與等待後，我們終於將 EpicFight-Nightfall 升級至全新版本——Nightfall 3。本次更新重點擴展了動畫框架，引入多款精心設計的武器，涵蓋以下內容：
After a long period of development and waiting, we have finally upgraded EpicFight-Nightfall to the new version—Nightfall 2. This update focuses on expanding the animation framework and introduces several meticulously designed weapons, covering the following content:

完全手繪製作的數百個流暢動畫
Hundreds of smooth, entirely hand-drawn animations

每類武器配備獨立建模與視覺設計
Each weapon type features independent modeling and visual design

支援運鏡動畫、特效實體與著色器
Supports camera animation, effect entities, and shaders

每種武器具備獨特的戰鬥機制與操作手感
Each weapon has unique combat mechanics and handling feel

⚔️ 武器與技能一覽：
⚔️ Weapons & Skills Overview:

▪ 殘骸大劍
▪ Ruin Greatsword

抗爭：按下 Key3 發動上挑斬，若與敵人攻擊相撞可抵消傷害並觸發強力連擊
Struggle: Press Key3 to perform an uppercut; if it collides with an enemy attack, it cancels damage and triggers a powerful combo

蠻勇：同時按住左右鍵蓄力，攻擊命中的瞬間可抵消所受傷害
Bravado: Hold both mouse buttons to charge; upon hitting an attack, cancel received damage at the moment of impact

▪黃昏之火
▪Duskfire

餘火：能量滿時同時按住左右鍵蓄力，揮動引發火焰風暴，可轉為橫掃或突刺；火焰極致時覆蓋全身，強化攻擊
Embers: When energy is full, hold both mouse buttons to charge, swinging to summon a flame storm that can transition into a sweep or thrust; at maximum flame, envelops the body, enhancing attacks

爆燃：處於「黃昏之火」狀態下按 Key3 釋放全部火焰與風暴力量
Ignition: While under the "Duskfire" state, press Key3 to release all flame and storm power

▪ 遠古幽匿對刀
▪ Ancient Echo Blades

處決：短按 Key3 挑飛敵人，長按追加終結一擊
Execution: Tap Key3 to launch an enemy, hold to add a finishing strike

預感：在受擊瞬間閃避可快速位移並反擊
Premonition: Dodge at the moment of being hit to quickly reposition and counterattack

▪ 先鋒軍佩刀
▪ Vanguard Saber

潰防：按下 Key3 先發動快斬搶佔先機，再以劍柄擊破防禦
Breach: Press Key3 to first unleash a swift slash to seize initiative, then strike with the hilt to break defenses

▪ 放逐之刃
▪ Blade of Exile

雙持特定武器時，左鍵與 Key3 組合將觸發不同招式
When dual-wielding specific weapons, combining left click and Key3 triggers different moves

▪ 女皇短刃
▪ Queen's Short Blade

重演：按下key3，下次攻擊將附加3.5秒前的一次傷害

Replay: Press key3, and the next attack will deal additional damage from 3.5 seconds agoe

▪ 狂野爪
▪ Wild Claws

狂暴：按下 Key3 進入狂暴狀態，免疫控制、提升移速與攻擊，但承受更多傷害
Frenzy: Press Key3 to enter a frenzied state, granting control immunity, increased movement speed and attack, but taking more damage

▪ 血癲狂 / 噬骨血癲
▪ Blood Mania / Bone-Devouring Blood Mania

血祭：按下 Key3 獻祭血液激活魔刃，進入黑白紅視覺模式，攻擊釋放血色劍氣，但同時持續損失生命
Blood Sacrifice: Press Key3 to sacrifice blood and activate the demonic blade, entering a black-white-red visual mode, attacks release blood-colored sword beams, but continuously lose health

▪ 閻魔刀 + 幻影劍
▪ Yamato + Phantom Swords

高度還原《DMC》維吉爾戰鬥風格，含大量專屬動畫。鼓勵玩家自主探索連招與機制，真正掌握其力量
Highly recreates Vergil's combat style from "DMC," including numerous exclusive animations. Players are encouraged to independently explore combos and mechanics to truly master its power

▪ 高頻村雨
▪ HF-MURASAMA

▪ 楔丸+不死斬-拜淚
▪Kusabimaru+Mortal Blade-HaiRui

▪ 基薩的刺輪
▪Ghiza's Wheel

▪ 赤月
▪CRIMSON_MOON

▪ 抗戰大刀
▪Warriors-BroadBlade

▪ 儺面偃月
▪CrescentMoon

 

▪ 夜幕武技
▪ Nightfall Combat Arts

【裂空審判】『Judgement Cut End』

【斬切模式】『Blade Mode』

【重力踐踏】『Gravity Stomp』

【獵魂】『Soul Hunt』

【不死斬-拜淚】『Mortal Blade-HaiRui』
